newsitem.title: CUBA: Vatican official in Cuba to prepare papal visit.
newsitem.headline: Vatican official in Cuba to prepare papal visit.

text.p: The Vatican official charged with preparing details of Pope John Paul's trips abroad, Roberto Tucci, arrived in Havana on Monday to work on the papal visit to Cuba in January next year.
Tucci was met at Havana airport by Cuba's Cardinal Jaime Ortega and the papal nuncio in Cuba, Beniamino Stella.
Tucci, expected to go over the details of the pope's planned January 21-25 trip to Cuba, declined to comment to waiting reporters.
Tucci, who will be in Cuba for five days, had been expected to visit Cuba in February but this trip was delayed when the pontiff organised a trip to Bosnia in April.
Cuban church officials have said the pope's programme in communist-ruled Cuba will include visits to Havana, the central city of Santa Clara and the eastern cities of Camaguey and Santiago de Cuba.

The papal visit was agreed at a historic first meeting last November at the Vatican between the John Paul and President Fidel Castro that marked a clear improvement in relations between the authorities and the Roman Catholic Church.
The date for the visit was announced in January.
Cuba is the only Spanish-speaking Latin American country that the 76-year-old pope has not visited.
